observed_outcome: Same-tenant revocation for a dual-principal pair bumps server-side grant_epoch via policy.changed and revokes principal_project_grants access to proj-alpha while leaving proj-beta intact. Reconnecting with a pre-revocation cursor returns a single terminal resync_required frame (reason='grant_epoch_changed'), GET /v1/hud/snapshot?project_id=proj-alpha returns HTTP 403, and legacy GET /v1/evidence/{id} and GET /v1/artifacts/{id} URLs return HTTP 403 for the revoked principal (signed_url=null for both principals before and after).
